From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Professorship in the University of Oxford

The **Sherardian Chair of Botany** is a professorship at the [University of Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Oxford "University of Oxford") that was established in 1734.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-Oxford_University_Gazette-1) It was created following an [endowment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Financial_endowment "Financial endowment") by [William Sherard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Sherard "William Sherard") on his death in 1728. In his will, Sherard stipulated that the first holder of the chair was to be [Johann Jacob Dillenius](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johann_Jacob_Dillenius "Johann Jacob Dillenius").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-2) The Sherardian Professor is also a [fellow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fellow_(college) "Fellow (college)") of [Magdalen College, Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magdalen_College,_Oxford "Magdalen College, Oxford")

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Professorship in the University of Oxford

The **Sherardian Chair of Botany** is a professorship at the [University of Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Oxford "University of Oxford") that was established in 1734.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-Oxford_University_Gazette-1) It was created following an [endowment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Financial_endowment "Financial endowment") by [William Sherard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Sherard "William Sherard") on his death in 1728. In his will, Sherard stipulated that the first holder of the chair was to be [Johann Jacob Dillenius](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johann_Jacob_Dillenius "Johann Jacob Dillenius").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-2) The Sherardian Professor is also a [fellow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fellow_(college) "Fellow (college)") of [Magdalen College, Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magdalen_College,_Oxford "Magdalen College, Oxford")

## List of Sherardian Professors of Botany

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: List of Sherardian Professors of Botany")]

*   [Johann Jacob Dillenius](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johann_Jacob_Dillenius "Johann Jacob Dillenius") (1734 to 1747)
*   [Humphry Sibthorp](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Humphry_Sibthorp_(botanist) "Humphry Sibthorp (botanist)") (1747 to 1783)
*   [John Sibthorp](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Sibthorp "John Sibthorp") (1784 to 1796)
*   [George Williams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Williams_(physician) "George Williams (physician)") (1796 to 1834)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-3)
*   [Charles Giles Bridle Daubeny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Daubeny "Charles Daubeny") (1834 to 1867)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-4)
*   [Marmaduke Alexander Lawson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marmaduke_Alexander_Lawson "Marmaduke Alexander Lawson") (1868 to 1882)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-5)
*   [Isaac Bayley Balfour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isaac_Bayley_Balfour "Isaac Bayley Balfour") (1884 to 1888)
*   [Sydney Howard Vines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sydney_Howard_Vines "Sydney Howard Vines") (1888 to 1919)
*   [Frederick Keeble](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Keeble "Frederick Keeble") (1920 to 1927)
*   [Arthur Tansley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arthur_Tansley "Arthur Tansley") (1927 to 1937)
*   [Theodore Osborn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodore_Osborn "Theodore Osborn") (1937 to 1953)
*   [C. D. Darlington](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C._D._Darlington "C. D. Darlington") (1953 to 1971)
*   [F. R. Whatley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/F._R._Whatley "F. R. Whatley") (1971 to 1991)
*   Hugh G. Dickinson (1991 to 2009)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-Oxford_University_Gazette-1)
*   [Liam Dolan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liam_Dolan "Liam Dolan") (2009 to 2021)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-6)
*   Lars Østergaard (2022 to present)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherardian_Professor_of_Botany#cite_note-7)
